title: Which ChatGPT Model Should You Use?
description:
If you never change the model in ChatGPT, you’re probably using it wrong.

Different tasks need different levels of speed and reasoning. Choosing the right one can make a huge difference.

Learn how to use ChatGPT and other AI tools in our free weekly live classes. Access them through the link in our profile.
